subject: Compact evening enablement - scheduling & backfill plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bluebayfinance.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact evening enablement - proposed windows

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Per our conversation, the BlueBay team prefers a condensed 90–120 minute console + API enablement (hands-on) rather than the full half-day workshop. To make this low-friction for your engineers, we can run a compact evening slot next week and keep it focused on: quick environment validation, Console walkthrough (routes, keys, tracing), and a 45m API lab with tokens and brief troubleshooting.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue May 2 — 5:30pm–7:00pm PDT
- Wed May 3 — 6:00pm–7:45pm PDT
- Thu May 4 — 5:00pm–6:45pm PDT (backup)

A few notes / asks:
- Please confirm timezone for attendees (I know some are in UTC). We can run in PDT and provide a recording.
- We will need 3 sandbox accounts created beforehand (I’ve included a short env access checklist attached).
- If you expect late joins, we can capture the first 20–30m as a recording and include a short recap doc.

Attaching: runbook_v1.pdf (agenda + prep), env_access_instructions.txt (sandbox steps).

If none of the windows work, tell me your preferred UTC hour and we’ll swap.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bluebayfinance.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2028 16:16:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Compact evening enablement - proposed windows

Rishi —

Thanks, that looks good. Two quick constraints from our side:
1) Most of the SW team is in GMT/UTC. An evening PDT slot is 2am for them, so the Tue/Thu options won't work.
2) Prefer a single 90-minute block during regular hours if possible (we can push coverage to the ops team in the US).

If you can do Wed May 3 at 14:00 UTC (that’s 7:00am PDT), we can make room for three engineers (me, Lina Gomez, and our infra lead Martin Lowe). If a 14:00 UTC slot isn’t available, propose any 13:00–15:00 UTC window that day.

Also: please confirm whether the onboarding will require any ACL changes from our side (we prefer minimal changes — tokens only).

Samir
Samir Patel | Head of Platform Integrations, BlueBay Finance
samir.patel@bluebayfinance.com

Ben — if you’re good, I’ll update the runbook to note the changed start time and add a brief ‘late join recap’ slide deck.

Camila

Sounds good — I can take the API lab at 14:00 UTC on Wed May 3. Quick ask: can we do a 20-minute pre-call 30 minutes before start (13:30 UTC) just to validate sandbox creds and that the recording hook is configured? I’ll plan lab tasks for 45 minutes and leave 15–25 minutes for troubleshooting/QA.

Ben

Subject: Compact evening enablement - scheduling & backfill plan (confirmed)

Great — thanks everyone. Confirming the compact enablement for BlueBay:

- Date: Wed, May 3, 2028
- Start: 14:00 UTC (13:30 UTC pre-call for sandbox/access validation)
- Duration: 90 minutes (Console walkthrough 30m, API lab 45m, QA 15m)
- Attendees (external): Samir Patel, Lina Gomez, Martin Lowe (infra)
- Internal leads: Camila Reyes (Console), Ben Carter (API lab), Rishi Malhotra (owner / follow-ups)

Attachments: runbook_v1.pdf (updated with time), env_access_instructions.txt; calendar invite attached (calendar_invite.ics). HubSpot: HS-Contact-3721; Runbook (shared): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRunbook

Samir — please add the three sandbox accounts and confirm they can access the API endpoints listed in the runbook before 13:30 UTC Wed. We’ll send a short recap and the recording within 24 hours.

See you Wed — I’ll send the calendar invite now.

—Rishi
